content: Ensholôlo za bene Israheli
Nyakasane anaciganiza Mûsa, amubwîra, erhi:
«Obwîre bene Israheli basholôle entûlo, ngasi bantu b’omurhima mwinjà boshi, ojè warhôla ezo nsholôlo zâbo.
Alaga ensholôlo wabahûna: amasholo, amarhale, emiringa,
emyenda y’akaduku, ey’omusengu, ecitàni calangashana, eswa, obwôya bw’empene,
empù z’ebigandabuzi z’akalinga, empù z’ebigoho n’emirhi y’akasiya,
amavurha gw’okuhira omu rhumole, omugavu gw’okuhira omu mavurha g’okucîshîga n’obukù bw’okuyôca.
Amabuye ga Onikisi n’amabuye g’okuj’omu efodi n’omu mwambalo g’oku cifuba.
Onjirire endâro lyo nkazibêra ekarhî kinyu.
Nienene nakuyêreka olugero lw’ecihando n’olugero lw’ebirugu byamwo byoshi: okwo kwonênè kwo wânajira.»
Omucîmba gw’amalaganyo
«Onjirire omucîmba gw’embaho za akasiya, gwa buli bwa makoro abirhi n’ecihimbi, bugali bw’ikoro liguma n’ecihimbi, na burherema bw’ikoro liguma n’ecihimbi.
“Ogushîge amasholo garhali mavange, ogushige omu ndalâlà n’emugongo, n’omuhiro gwâgwo oguzunguluse masholo”.
“Ogutulire mpogo inni za masholo, ozihire omu magulu gâgwo oku ganali anni, mpogo ibirhi lunda luguma n’ibirhi olundi lunda”.
“Ojire emirhamba y’emirhi ya akasiya, oyishîge amasholo”,
“onayishesheze omu mpogo z’amarhambi g’omucîmba, gukazibarhulirwâkwo”.
“Emirhamba ebêre omu mpogo z’omucîmba, erhakûlagwamwo”.
“Endagâno nakuhà oyibîke muli ogwo mucîmba
“Okubundi ogujirire omufûniko gw’amasholo gône gône, buli bwa makoro abirhi n’ecihimbi na bugali bw’ikoro liguma n’ecihimbi”.
“Ojire bakerubi
babirhi ba masholo; obatulire oku marhambi gombi gw’ogwo mufuniko”.
“Ohire kerubi muguma eburhambi buguma n’owundi ajè ebundi burhambi. Obahire oku muhiro gw’omufûniko, omu marhambi gombi”.
“Ebyûbi by’abôla bakerubi bishanjûkire enyanya, bakaz’ibwîkira omufûniko n’ebyûbi byâbo bayerekerane bombi, bakazilola ebwa mufuniko”.
“Ohire omufûniko enyanya ly’omucîmba n’omwo mucîmba mwo wahira Endagâno nâkuhà”.
“Aho, ho nakâbugânana nâwe, ho nakâkuganîriza, enyanya ly’omufûniko, ekarhî k’abo bakerubi babirhi bali oku mucîmba gw’Endagâno, nkâkubwîra byoshi ntegesire Bene Israheli.”»
Amêza g’emigati y’enterekêro
Kandi ojire ameza gw’omurhi gwa akasiya, gwa buli bwa makoro abirhi, bugali bw’ikoro liguma, na burhererema bw’ikoro liguma n’ecihimbi.
Ogashîge amasholo garhalimwo nvange, ogutâke n’amasholo.
Okwo muhiro, obinjûlekwo emikororonzi ya bugali bwa cihimbi c’ikoro, onazunguluse emikororonzi y’amasholo.
Ogajirire mpogo inni za masholo, zije oku bikwi binni by’amagulu gâbo oku ganali anni.
Ezo mpogo zije omu marhambi g’amagulu gâgo oku ganali anni, zikazijageramwo emirhamba y’okubarhula ameza.
Eyo mirhamba oyijire n’omurhi gwa akasiya, oyishîge amasholo, ekazikolesibwa oku kubarhula ameza.
Ameza ogajirire embale, ennambi, orhubêhè, enzînzi n’ebyânzi, byo bakaz’idubuliramwo enterekêro z’ebinyôbwa. Byoshi obijire bya masholo garhali mavange.
Okaziyôrha ohizire ensiku zoshi omugati gw’enterekêro okwo mêza, embere zâni.
Akamole ka mahaji nda
Kandi ojire akamole k’amasholo garhali mavange. Ako kamole, katulwe kalungire n’enteberhebe yako n’olusârhi lwâko, haguma n’amashami, ebigonyero n’obwâso bwâko.
Mahaji ndarhu garhenge omu marhambi gako: mahaji asharhu g’akamole eburhambi buguma na mahaji asharhu g’akamole ebundi burhambi.
Oku ngasi ihaji kuje mahaji asharhu galikwo amafufu n’obwâso. Ntyo kwo mahaji ndarhu garhenga omu kamole gajirwa gwoshi.
Nako akamole kône, kabè na mashami anni haguma n’amafufu n’obwâso bwâgo:

ifufu liguma omu mahaji abirhi marhanzi garhenga omu kamole, ifufu liguma omu gandi mahaji abirhi garhenga omu kamole, n’ifufu liguma omu mahaji abirhi mazinda garhenga omu kamole kwo n’okwo oku mahaji ndarhu goshi g’akamole.
Amafufu n’amahaji bilungîne n’akamole, byoshi bibè bitule muli cûma ciguma ca masholo garhali mavange.
Ojire rhumole nda: bakaz’iyâsa orhwo rhumole, rhumolekere embere n’eburhambi.
Ennâmbi zako n’amaganyi gakwo, byoshi bibè bya masholo gônene.
Bagajire na talenta nguma ya masholo gône gône, haguma n’ebigabi byako byoshi.
Olole bwinjà onajire nk’oku oyeresirwe oku ntondo.
